SELECT goods_no, goods_code, goods_name, goods_price, goods_discount, poster_url, subposter_url, b.brand_name, hit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_like gl WHERE gl.goods_no=g.goods_no) as like_count FROM goods g JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no=b.brand_no
g.category_no = #{category_no}
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(g.goods_price, '[^0-9]', '')) ASC
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(g.goods_price, '[^0-9]', '')) DESC
ORDER BY g.hit DESC
ORDER BY g.goods_no ASC
OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY

SELECT goods_no, goods_name, goods_code, goods_price, goods_discount, poster_url, subposter_url, hit, b.brand_name, c.category_name FROM goods g JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no = b.brand_no JOIN category c ON g.category_no=c.category_no WHERE g.goods_no=#{goods_no}

SELECT goods_no, goods_code, goods_name, goods_price, poster_url, b.brand_name, hit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_like gl WHERE gl.goods_no=g.goods_no) as like_count FROM goods g JOIN brand b ON g.brand_no=b.brand_no
g.category_no=#{cno} AND
g.goods_name LIKE '%'||#{fd}||'%'
ORDER BY g.goods_no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/12.0) FROM goods g
g.category_no=#{cno} AND
g.goods_name LIKE '%'||#{fd}||'%'
